summary: This note is a short biography of Ferenc Bene, a Hungarian football striker born in 1944 and died in 2006. He played for Újpesti Dózsa and was part of the Hungarian team that won the gold medal at the 1964 Summer Olympics in Tokyo. He was the tournament's top scorer with 12 goals in 5 matches.
one_line: Ferenc Bene was a Hungarian striker for Újpesti Dózsa, the 1964 Olympic gold medalist and tournament top scorer.
